summary: Enforced specification by fixing analytics endpoint SurrealDB queries and configuring dashboard for local mode authentication bypass

changesApplied.changeMade: Wrapped SELECT query with SELECT VALUE syntax and explicit field mapping. Changed math::sum(success == true) to math::sum(IF success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END). Changed ORDER BY execution_count to ORDER BY count().
changesApplied.reason: Fix AttributeError caused by SurrealDB GROUP BY returning strings instead of dictionaries. SELECT VALUE ensures results are proper dictionary objects that support .get() method calls.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low impact - Query output format unchanged (still returns dictionaries), only fixes internal query structure. Consumers (DevelopmentProgressDashboard.js, MetabobRestApi.js) expect dictionary format and will work correctly once endpoint returns 200 instead of 500.
changesApplied.before: SELECT template_id, count() as execution_count, ... FROM activity_executions GROUP BY template_id
changesApplied.after: SELECT VALUE { template_id: template_id, execution_count: count(), ... } FROM activity_executions GROUP BY template_id

changesApplied.changeMade: Wrapped SELECT query with SELECT VALUE syntax and explicit field mapping. Changed math::sum(success == true) to math::sum(IF success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END).
changesApplied.reason: Prevent same AttributeError that affects get_activity_templates(). Proactive fix to ensure improvement roadmap endpoint doesn't fail with same SurrealDB GROUP BY issue.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low impact - Query output format unchanged. Dashboard component (if exists) and data-bridge-server.js will receive proper dictionary results instead of strings.
changesApplied.before: SELECT template_id, count() as execution_count, ... FROM activity_executions GROUP BY template_id HAVING count() >= $min_executions
changesApplied.after: SELECT VALUE { template_id: template_id, execution_count: count(), ... } FROM activity_executions GROUP BY template_id HAVING count() >= $min_executions

changesApplied.changeMade: Added env section with REACT_APP_DEPLOYMENT_MODE=local, REACT_APP_SKIP_AUTH='true', REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL='http://localhost:8080'
changesApplied.reason: Configure dashboard deployment to run in local mode without authentication. Enables browser access to Activity History view by bypassing CloudApp authentication flow.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium impact - Changes dashboard deployment behavior from cloud mode (requires auth) to local mode (no auth). Affects App.js routing (lines 160-168) which checks CONFIG.IS_CLOUD_MODE. When local mode, renders LocalAppContent instead of CloudApp, bypassing authentication entirely.
